info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Facilities Equipment Administration By Equipment Administration Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Facilities Equipment Administration Update API allows users to modify existing equipment administration records by their unique identifiers. This endpoint is particularly valuable for financial institutions and facilities managers who need to keep their equipment data current and accurate. Typical use cases include updating equipment details such as status, specifications, or operational attributes. By ensuring that all stakeholders have access to the latest information, it enhances operational efficiency and decision-making processes.

patch.description: This operation allows the user to update the details of an existing equipment reservation identified by the reservation ID. Make sure to provide the necessary data in the request body to successfully modify the reservation.
